title: mobile.de Dealer Inventory Scraper
description: Browse mobile.de dealer inventory with vehicle titles, prices, mileage, registration, images, and listing IDs. Batch dealer IDs to compare used car stock across sellers.

batch.title: Dealer IDs
batch.description: mobile.de dealer identifiers whose car stock you want to browse.
batch.valueDescription: dealer ID whose mobile.de inventory is being searched.

schema.description: Validated marketplace model identifier. Requires make_id.
Dealer identifier returned by a listing.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Browse mobile.de dealer inventory with vehicle titles, prices, mileage, registration, and listing IDs. Batch dealers to compare stock across sellers.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve cars offered by mobile.de dealers, including vehicle titles, make and model, prices, mileage, registration, and listing links. Batch dealer IDs to compare inventory.
useCases: Dealers can benchmark their stock against other mobile.de sellers.
Automotive researchers can compare inventory depth by dealer.
Car buyers can review vehicles listed by a known dealer before visiting.
howToUse: Add one mobile.de dealer ID to `dealer_ids` per inventory search.
Set a page size and optional price, year, mileage, or model filters.
Limit pages and results, then export the vehicle rows.

faqs.question: Where can I find a dealer ID?
faqs.answer: Use the dealer identifier associated with a mobile.de listing or dealer profile.
